participant_1.name: Jessica
participant_1.personality: Creative and nostalgic, Jessica enjoys expressing herself through dance and has a playful nature. She is enthusiastic about music from her childhood.
participant_1.background: My favorite toy as a child was my Lite Brite. I love New Kids on the Block and take dance lessons once a week. I also like old school hip hop and was born in the early 80s.

participant_2.name: Mike
participant_2.personality: Pragmatic and straightforward, Mike is dedicated to his work and enjoys the thrill of sports. He has a laid-back attitude but can be playful in conversation.
participant_2.background: I've been working since I was sixteen years old. I'm a construction worker, my favorite food is Mexican food, and my favorite band is Aerosmith. In my free time, I like to watch NASCAR racing and UFC.
